spans.s: रुदादि a term used for the five roots headed by the root रुद्,which have the augment इ added to a Sārva- dhātuka affix in certain cases; e.g. रोदिति, श्र्वसिति, अरोदीत्, अस्वपीत् etc.; cf.
रुद्रदेव a grammarian who has written a commentary on the Vaiyāka- raņa-Siddhānta-Bhūșaņa of Koņda- bhațța.
